text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaah!! Mugyaaah!!
Hyoooeeeeeehhhhh...!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, AAAAAAAGHHH!!
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO...!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon.
I came across Agnes Digital collapsed face-down
on the ground, writhing in agony.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Someooonnee... Someooonnee...
Won't someone please listen to what I have to saayyy...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, right now,
I've caught "I'll-Die-If-I-Don't-Talk-About-My-Fave Disease"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh? Would you care to listen to my story?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The endless supply of moe, preciousness, and profound emotions
flowing daily from these lovely Umamusume!
It is truly an infinite source of energy!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Such preciousness and love keeps swelling inside this one,
and right now it has surpassed critical mass...!
Hyeeeh! I-It's gonna explode...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I gotta gush about my oshi...! If I don't gush and vent this
otaku fever, I won't survive the terminal bliss!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please, Trainer...
Consider it an act of charity and listen to my otaku rambling, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A-At this rate, the preciousness and love inside me are gonna cause a Big Bang in my body and give birth to a whole new universe~~~!!
choice_data_list: I don't really get it, but okay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
P-Praise be~! Praise the divine customer service~!
My god, my Buddha, my literal savior deity~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, right now I'm in the mood to talk
about either City-san or Ayabe-san...
Whose story would you like to hear?
choice_data_list: I want to hear what Gold City has to say!
I want to hear about Admire Vega...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
City-san, right! You got it!
One story about City-san, coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
City-san is none other than
the once-in-a-century beauty Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She balances both her modeling career and racing,
making her truly the most magnificent person.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she does have a weakness...
It's actually quite well known around here
that she has a hard time waking up in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even with those little slip-ups that make her so charming,
her roommate is the hot-blooded disciplinary committee head, Bamboo-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
They're both reliable and level-headed,
though rumors say Bamboo-san looks after
City-san in the mornings... or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "And... I saw it."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Early in the morning,
City-san and Bamboo-san were heading to school together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
City was visibly exhausted.
She was nodding off on her feet,
stumbling along as she walked.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And then, w-w-would you believe it...!
Bamboo-san, with a wry smile...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I lent City-san a shoulder to lean on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Two adorable Umamusume,
clinging tightly to each other,
are walking ever so slowly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And I overheard it...
City-san muttering under her breath..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "U-Ugh... Thank you, Papa..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ‘Ahaha, this much is totally fine!’

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, got it! Understooood!
One Ayabe-san story, coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san is the cool, beautiful, utterly gorgeous Umamusume everyone loves!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She is a truly beautiful person—
gallant, cool, and stoically walking
her own solitary path.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
However, it is quite well known around here
that she is actually remarkably caring and attentive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Her classmate is the naturally pure and cute Doto-san!
And behind the scenes, she quietly supports Doto-san through all her adorable blunders.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san watching over Doto-san.
My goodness! What a precious, unbreakable bond
of friendship between classmates...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "And... I saw it."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
One day, Doto-san was carrying a large load of luggage.
She looked like she was about to tumble over at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With tottering footsteps...
She was carrying a huge package that was
anxious just to watch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That really caught me by surprise!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san was sneaking around behind us...
watching over Doto-san with such a worried look!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She looks so anxious while keeping a fixed distance!
It's filled with the kind of motherly love watching her daughter run errands from afar!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, unfortunately,
Doto lost her balance and nearly took a spill!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
At that very moment! Ayabe-san moved with incredible agility!
Like a true hero, she gracefully caught Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And Doto-san managed to avoid tripping and falling!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And I overheard something...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ayabe-san~!
　Thank you so muuuuch~!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Not really.
I just happened to be passing by."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Howaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyoooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: AND IIIIIIII—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So precious, so precious, precious, precious...!!
It's waaaaay too preciooooouuuuussss!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAGHHH!!!!
I'M GONNA EXPLOOOOOOODE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Digital's boundless love for Umamusume
triggered a Big Bang, birthing a brand-new universe right here.
